entities.name: Devil's Breach
entities.description: Fiery cave in the rocky hills of Kessig on Innistrad, dwelling of devils whose nightly raids threaten the countryside.

entities.name: Kessig
entities.description: Region of Innistrad containing Devil's Breach.

entities.name: Inquisitor Verena
entities.description: Cathar from Avabruck who returned to Kessig to protect villagers and stayed to hunt the devils.

entities.name: Cathars
entities.description: Order of soldiers that Verena led to Kessig.

entities.name: Lunarch Inquisition
entities.description: Organization that recalled Verena's troop to Gavony.

entities.name: Helvault
entities.description: Artifact whose shattering is said to have widened the cave.

entities.name: Travails
entities.description: Period of danger on Innistrad during which devils made twisting paths through the woods.

events.summary: Devils created torch-lit twisting paths through the woods around the Breach.
events.quote: the devils created torch-lit, twisting paths through the surrounding woods

events.summary: Verena returned to Kessig with Cathar soldiers to protect villagers but met mistrust.
events.quote: Verena arrived with a company of Cathar soldiers but faced mistrust and fear from the people she was trying to protect.

events.summary: Verena defied the Lunarch Inquisition's recall to Gavony and camped near Devil's Breach, organizing volunteer patrols against the devils.
events.quote: Verena defied her orders and stayed behind.

relations.quote: Devil's Breach is a fiery cave in the rocky hills of Kessig on Innistrad .

relations.note: hunts the devils emerging from it
relations.quote: organized volunteer patrols of warriors and rangers to hunt the devils and stop their raids
